sections.heading: 1. Walk-run intervals

② Repeat 8 times, 3 days a week, rest between.

caption:
Never run before? Your first 5km is closer than you think. 🏃

The trick is starting slower than feels necessary. Try one minute of easy jogging and two minutes of walking, eight times over, three days a week. Add a little each week, and repeat any week that felt tough. Many beginners take around eight to ten weeks to get there.

Two short strength sessions a week help your legs cope. In summer, run early or late, carry water and slow down on hot days.

Mild aches that settle within a day are usually fine. Limping, pain that builds as you run or pain in one spot on a bone is worth getting checked by our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios. Book online via the link in bio.
